name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly after a successful career managing a traditional Romanian restaurant. Her knack for organization and passion for delivering exceptional culinary experiences caught the eye of a scout from Elite Motorsport, who recognized her potential to elevate their hospitality program. 

Elena's approach is all about fueling the team, both literally and figuratively. She meticulously plans menus to optimize performance, considering dietary needs and preferences of each team member. She prides herself on sourcing local, high-quality ingredients, and infuses a touch of Romanian flair into her creations. Elena's loyalty extends to her team, fostering a positive and supportive environment in the catering department, making her an invaluable asset to Elite Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a warm smile and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always has a small, handwritten notebook filled with recipe ideas and catering schedules.
Insists on brewing a strong, traditional Romanian coffee for the team every morning.
Secretly judges the quality of the coffee at rival team's hospitality suites.
